criteria.criterion: The blacklist removes the literal words or/AND but the true && payload still returns the normal row.
criteria.evidence: normal (id=1) and true (id=1' && '1'='1) both return the Dumb/Dumb login row at HTTP 200; body 892 vs 903 bytes, difference consistent with the longer reflected hint. Recorded filter is only preg_replace('/or/i','') and preg_replace('/AND/i',''), so '&&' survives and the injected boolean AND evaluates true, reproducing the normal row.

criteria.criterion: The false payload, differing only in the compared constant, returns no row.
criteria.evidence: false (id=1' && '1'='2) is identical to true except '1'='2'; status 200, body 852 bytes, and the login-name element is empty (<font color="#FFFF00"></font>) with no 'Your Login name' text, i.e. no row. This differential rules out reflection/page-size artifacts.

criteria.criterion: The filtered hint shows the blacklist did not remove the && operator.
criteria.evidence: The hint for both true and false echoes the full payloads "1' && '1'='1" and "1' && '1'='2" with the '&&' intact, while normal echoes "1"; correct single quotes are also preserved, confirming no removal of the logical operator.

rationale: 三组请求仅 id 载荷不同：normal 与 true 均返回 Dumb 行，false 仅把比较常量改为 '2' 即无行，且提示回显保留完整 &&。差异行为只能由注入的布尔表达式解释，说明黑名单未拦截 &&，条件被触发。
missing_evidence: A positive-control payload using the literal words 'or'/'AND' (e.g. 1' AND '1'='1) showing the blacklist actually strips them; criterion 1's removal clause is supported only by the recorded filter description, not by an observed filtered input.
Full untruncated response bodies and a local recomputation of the provided response_sha256 values, so the quoted snippets can be tied byte-for-byte to the recorded responses.
Coverage beyond the Less-25 GET id path (other parameters/endpoints) if the label is meant to generalize beyond this path; the packet itself limits the claim to this path.
